citizens.name: template_citizen
citizens.role: skeleton/template for a SARA-powered C# program module or user agent

word.notes: Word can only read and parse document-style files for analytics or display. No writing or appending allowed via the bridge.

excel.notes: Excel can only read and parse spreadsheet files for analytics or display. No writing or appending allowed via the bridge.

vscode.notes: VS Code can read and parse any code file for analytics or code review, but cannot write or append via the bridge.

blender.notes: Blender can only read and parse 3D model files for analytics, preview, or display. No writing or appending allowed via the bridge.

citizens.description: Use this template to create new C# modules or user agents. All file operations are routed through SARA's CONTROL and SECURITY pillars, ensuring safe, auditable, and intentional evolution. Stubs are only filled by AI when explicitly allowed; otherwise, manual work is required. Each environment (Word, Excel, VS Code) has minimal, strictly separated permissions: only reading/parsing for analytics is allowed, no writing or appending to document or spreadsheet files via the bridge.

changelog.change: Initial governance, audit, and profile system section added.
